title: What If the Last Ice Age Came Back Tomorrow?

scenes.text: What if the ice age came back? Ice over Canada would be about three kilometers thick.
Last time, around twenty thousand years ago, ice covered about a quarter of all the land on Earth.
The world was only about six degrees Celsius colder than today. That is all it took.
So much water was locked in ice that the sea sat roughly one hundred twenty meters lower.
Shallow seas became dry land, including a land bridge between Asia and North America.
Ice reached the Great Lakes and the northern United States. Six degrees is the gap between our world and that one.

description:
What if the last ice age came back?
Twenty thousand years ago ice covered a quarter of the land, the sea was about 120 meters lower, and the world was only about 6 degrees colder.
What should we run through next?
